title: Hearthlands/Tithing never exposed an explicit 'settle this hold's grief' action/location the way every other hold did (Fenmarch's bell, Thornwold's tree-names, Wardmoor's oath-stone). I fully completed 'The Tithe Question' and 'The Almoner's Ledger' there but the 'Hollows rested' counter never incremented for it, and I could not find a granary-interior or equivalent grief site despite the barn being made 'common.'
